title: POST /api/integration/family/notify-answer
description: Integration token only. A button of an actionable Home Assistant notification for a child's request was pressed (event mobile_app_notification_action, action <NS>_FAMILY_<token>). The token (16 random bytes, base64url) is single-use, bound to one request and one notify action (data/family.json notify_actions) and dies with the request; the hub stores only its SHA-256. ha_user_name and notify_service are recorded in the log (route ha_notification). Not a login: whoever holds the notification can answer it, therefore only targets the admin linked to a family manager or chose for kids_release_requested get buttons.
